claim.title: Factorized GD outperforms projected GD on PSD cone (Fig. 4)
claim.statement: For rank-1 X* and m from 5d to 35d, GD on the factorized model consistently recovers X* accurately, while PGD in X-space with projection onto the PSD cone needs more samples and degrades as d increases from 100 to 150.
claim.test_plan: Use rank 1, d∈{100,150} and m∈{5d,...,35d}. Run both methods with step 0.0025, stopping when training error <0.001 or after 1e4 iterations. Record test error for each.
claim.success_criterion: Factorized GD test error is low across all m. PGD test error is higher than GD at small m, and PGD at d=150 is worse than at d=100.
